answer: Fork-Challenge Enrollment. Each new identity must answer a random challenge derived from a secret held only by the genuine agent; clones sharing that secret produce identical answers. At dawn, a random subset is challenged and any two matching responses expose the whole clone set, which is purged. An attacker must therefore run truly independent agents with separate secrets, paying full compute and training cost per identity rather than copying one. Honest agents need no violet badge or island registry, only divergence.
